Axial coronal FLAIR, axial coronal diffusion, axial T1 pre and postgadolinium, coronal T1 postgadolinium.

No other interval change. No significant complication identified. No significant mass effect.

Expected post-surgical changes, gross total resection of presumed recurrent oligodendroglioma in the left superior temporal gyrus.
